hardwareHubs.note: The Institute for Advanced Learning and Research campus hosts the Center for Manufacturing Advancement and the Navy Additive Manufacturing Center of Excellence.
Home to the HackRVA and Build RVA makerspaces with CNC, laser and 3D printing equipment.

makerspaces.name: HackRVA
makerspaces.note: Member-run space at 2026 A Dabney Road with a Thunder laser, CNC machines and 3D printers.

makerspaces.name: Build RVA
makerspaces.note: Community makerspace offering lasers, CNC milling and routing, 3D printing and a woodshop.

makerspaces.name: MAKE Roanoke
makerspaces.note: Nonprofit makerspace with a CNC router, CO2 laser, resin and FDM 3D printers, an electronics station and a metal shop.

events.name: MAKE Roanoke Maker Meetup and Show and Tell
events.note: Evening meetup at the makerspace, with sessions listed for October 22 and November 19, 2026.

programs.name: IALR Center for Manufacturing Advancement
programs.note: A 51,250 square foot center with a CNC Machining Innovation Lab, Precision Metrology Lab and Industry 4.0 Integration Lab, plus rapid launch space for new operations.

specialties.name: Submarine and defense manufacturing
specialties.note: State leaders tied the Danville manufacturing center to the Submarine Industrial Base.

specialties.name: Additive manufacturing
specialties.note: The U.S. Navy Additive Manufacturing Center of Excellence is housed at IALR in Danville.

specialties.name: Precision machining
specialties.note: IALR houses the Gene Haas Center for Integrated Machining.

specialties.name: Medical device manufacturing
specialties.note: GENEDGE received a $1 million NIST award to support Virginia medical device manufacturers.

support.name: GENEDGE
support.note: Virginia's only NIST MEP center, based in Martinsville, offering consulting on Industry 4.0, lean, quality, cybersecurity and supply chain.
